requirements.verifier_assertion: test_outputs.py asserts os.path.exists('/workspace/output.xlsx'); a missing output file scores 0.
The reg/mod split is computed against /workspace/data/input.xlsx (or input_ref.xlsx); the agent must build from the provided input workbook.
ANSWER_POSITION = "'furtherex2'!A33:K113"; scoring and the regression/modification classification are restricted to this sheet+range.
The modification (blank) cells the reference fills are the named furtherex2 line-items; every such cell must match golden within tolerance.
Regression cells (identical between input and golden) must stay identical in the output; altering non-target cells drops regression below 1.0 and fails.
must_include: Do not alter any other cell

requirements.verifier_assertion: The grader LibreOffice-recomputes the output and compares resulting values against the reference with 1% numeric tolerance; cells may hold formulas or computed values.
Modification denominator must be fully satisfied: every period column of each named line-item must be filled (any unfilled target cell fails).
must_include: Every period column of each named line-item must be filled

requirements.verifier_assertion: acc = 1.0 iff reg_ratio == 1.0 AND mod_ratio == 1.0; reward 1.0 requires both regression and modification at 100%.
